extracted.name: Creamy Parmesan Sauce for Fish
extracted.description: The best sauce for fish is this creamy mayo-Parmesan cheese topping seasoned with lemon, dill, and hot sauce spread onto cod fillets, then broiled.
ingredient_lines: 2 dashes hot pepper sauce (such as Tabasco®)
instruction_lines: Gather the ingredients. Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil; lightly coat with 1 teaspoon butter.
Mix together Parmesan, 1/3 cup butter, mayonnaise, green onion, lemon juice, dill, salt, black pepper, and hot sauce in a medium bowl until well combined. Set aside.
Lay cod fillets in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Cook under the preheated broiler until fish flakes easily with a fork, 7 to 8 minutes.
Gently spread Parmesan mixture over fish; return to the oven and broil until topping is bubbly and lightly browned, about 2 more minutes.
